# ---- Orchestrator ------------------------------------------------------------
def _force_layout_recalculation(ctx):
    """Force complete layout recalculation after hover cards are attached."""
    try:
        ctx.dropdown_container.updateGeometry()
        ctx.dropdown_container.adjustSize()
        ctx.dropdown_scroll.updateGeometry()
        ctx._sync_chrome_heights()

        # Recalculate spacer stretches
        if hasattr(ctx, '_left_spacer') and hasattr(ctx, '_right_spacer'):
            ctx.dropdown_layout.setStretch(0, 1)  # left spacer
            ctx.dropdown_layout.setStretch(ctx.dropdown_layout.count() - 1, 1)  # right spacer

        QCoreApplication.processEvents()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Layout recalculation error: {e}")

def update_dropdowns(ctx) -> None:
    """
    Rebuild the dropdown lane (Core/Pro) from the current maps/selection.

    Steps
    -----
    1) Prepare lifecycle + dependency inputs
    2) Resolve lane pairs (core/pro) and coerce valid selection if needed
    3) Prepare lane (clear, freeze updates, add left spacer)
    4) Build combos for the active lane, size, populate, connect signals
    5) Add right spacer; unfreeze; geometry + headers refresh
    6) Rebuild key index; recompute dependencies; debug dumps
    7) Emit an initial snapshot; post-hook
    """
    print("⚠️ [CALLED] update_dropdowns")
    log.debug("=== UPDATE_DROPDOWNS STARTED ===")

    # 1) lifecycle flags & dependency inputs
    _lifecycle_begin(ctx)

    # 2) lane pairs and valid selection
    core_pairs, pro_pairs = _compute_lane_pairs(ctx)
    core_pairs, pro_pairs = _coerce_valid_selection_if_needed(ctx, core_pairs, pro_pairs)

    # 3) prep lane for rebuild
    _prep_lane(ctx)

    # 4) build all combos for the active lane
    combined = _choose_active_pairs(ctx, core_pairs, pro_pairs)
    built = _build_all_combos(ctx, combined)

    # 5) finalize lane visuals
    _finalize_lane_visuals(ctx)

    # 6) deps + debug
    _post_build_dependencies_and_debug(ctx)

    # 7) lifecycle end + initial snapshot + hook
    _lifecycle_end_and_emit(ctx, built)

    # 8) FORCE LAYOUT RECALCULATION AFTER ALL DROPDOWNS ARE BUILT
    QTimer.singleShot(200, lambda: _force_layout_recalculation(ctx))

    log.debug("=== UPDATE_DROPDOWNS COMPLETED ===")

# ---- Phase helpers -----------------------------------------------------------

def _lifecycle_begin(ctx) -> None:
    ctx._first_layout_pass_done = False
    ctx._building_lane = True
    params_after_deps, _notes = ctx._safe_compute_params_after_dependencies()
    ctx._params_after_deps = params_after_deps

def _compute_lane_pairs(ctx) -> Tuple[Pairs, Pairs]:
    def _pairs_for(main_key, caret_key, direct_map, nested_map):
        return pairs_for_lane(main_key, caret_key, direct_map, nested_map)

    core_pairs = _pairs_for(ctx.core_main, ctx.core_caret, ctx.core_direct_map, ctx.core_nested_map)
    pro_pairs = _pairs_for(ctx.pro_main, ctx.pro_caret, ctx.pro_direct_map, ctx.pro_nested_map)
    log.debug(f"Core pairs: {len(core_pairs or [])}, Pro pairs: {len(pro_pairs or [])}")
    return core_pairs or [], pro_pairs or []

def _coerce_valid_selection_if_needed(ctx, core_pairs: Pairs, pro_pairs: Pairs) -> Tuple[Pairs, Pairs]:
    if core_pairs or pro_pairs:
        return core_pairs, pro_pairs

    changed = False
    # core main
    if not (ctx.core_main and (ctx.core_main in ctx.core_direct_map or ctx.core_main in ctx.core_nested_map)):
        ctx.core_main = next(iter(ctx.core_direct_map or ctx.core_nested_map or {}), None)
        changed = True
    if ctx.core_main in ctx.core_nested_map and not ctx.core_caret:
        ctx.core_caret = next(iter(ctx.core_nested_map[ctx.core_main]), None)  # type: ignore[index]
        changed = True
    # pro main
    if not (ctx.pro_main and (ctx.pro_main in ctx.pro_direct_map or ctx.pro_main in ctx.pro_nested_map)):
        ctx.pro_main = next(iter(ctx.pro_direct_map or ctx.pro_nested_map or {}), None)
        changed = True
    if ctx.pro_main in ctx.pro_nested_map and not ctx.pro_caret:
        ctx.pro_caret = next(iter(ctx.pro_nested_map[ctx.pro_main]), None)  # type: ignore[index]
        changed = True

    if changed:
        ctx._rebuild_core_caret_menu()
        ctx._rebuild_pro_caret_menu()
        return _compute_lane_pairs(ctx)

    return core_pairs, pro_pairs

def _prep_lane(ctx) -> None:
    ctx._clear_dropdown_lane()
    ctx.dropdown_container.setUpdatesEnabled(False)

    # 🔧 Ensure dropdown container has room to grow and expand
    lane_min_width = getattr(ctx, "_dropdown_lane_min_width", 800)
    ctx.dropdown_container.setMinimumWidth(lane_min_width)
    ctx.dropdown_container.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Fixed)

    # ✨ Improve layout spacing and margins for visual polish
    ctx.dropdown_layout.setContentsMargins(12, 0, 12, 0)
    ctx.dropdown_layout.setSpacing(6)

    # 🔧 Add invisible filler widget (helps maintain layout width under shrink)
    ctx._lane_filler = QWidget()
    ctx._lane_filler.setMinimumWidth(600)
    ctx._lane_filler.setVisible(False)
    ctx.dropdown_layout.addWidget(ctx._lane_filler)

    # ↔️ Add left and right spacers to center lane content
    ctx._left_spacer = QSpacerItem(0, 0, QSizePolicy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Minimum)
    ctx._right_spacer = QSpacerItem(0, 0, QSizePolicy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Minimum)
    ctx.dropdown_layout.addItem(ctx._left_spacer)

def _choose_active_pairs(ctx, core_pairs: Pairs, pro_pairs: Pairs) -> Pairs:
    combined: Pairs = []
    if getattr(ctx, "_active_lane", "core") == "core":
        combined.extend(core_pairs)
    else:
        combined.extend(pro_pairs)
    log.debug(f"Combined pairs count: {len(combined)}")
    for i, (label, items) in enumerate(combined):
        log.debug(f"Pair {i}: {label} -> {list(items)[:3]}...")
    return combined

def _build_all_combos(ctx, combined: Pairs) -> List[Tuple[str, QComboBox]]:
    built: List[Tuple[str, QComboBox]] = []

    # sizing toggles
    use_fast_default = bool(getattr(ctx, "_use_fast_charlen_widths", True))
    char_buf = int(getattr(ctx, "_contents_len_buffer", 3))
    precise_keys = set(getattr(ctx, "_precise_size_keys", set()))
    width_scale = float(getattr(ctx, "_dropdown_width_scale", 0.6))

    for label, items in combined:
        combo, logical_key = _build_one_combo(
            ctx=ctx,
            label=str(label),
            items=list(items),
            use_fast_default=use_fast_default,
            char_buf=char_buf,
            precise_keys=precise_keys,
            width_scale=width_scale,
        )
        ctx.dropdown_layout.addWidget(combo)
        ctx._dropdowns[f"{logical_key}::{label}"] = combo
        built.append((str(label), combo))

    # right spacer for symmetry
    ctx.dropdown_layout.addItem(ctx._right_spacer)
    return built

def _build_one_combo(
    *,
    ctx,
    label: str,
    items: Sequence[str],
    use_fast_default: bool,
    char_buf: int,
    precise_keys: set,
    width_scale: float,
) -> Tuple[QComboBox, str]:
    """Build, size, populate, connect, and decorate one QComboBox."""
    print(f"Building combo: {label}")

    combo = KandaDropdown(row_h=ctx._row_h)
    combo.setFixedHeight(ctx._row_h)

    logical_key = ctx._label_to_key.get(label, label)
    tipcfg = _resolve_tipcfg(ctx, logical_key, label)

    print(f"Combo {label} - tipcfg: {bool(tipcfg)}")
    if tipcfg:
        print(f"Tooltip keys: {list(tipcfg.keys())}")

    # Determine sizing path
    use_fast = use_fast_default and (logical_key not in precise_keys)
    pre, suf = get_caption_affixes(key=logical_key, label=label, tipcfg=tipcfg)

    if use_fast:
        apply_caption_aware_fast_sizing(
            combo, items, key=logical_key, label=label,
            tipcfg=tipcfg, char_buffer=char_buf, width_scale=width_scale,
        )
    else:
        apply_caption_aware_precise_sizing(
            combo, items, key=logical_key, label=label,
            tipcfg=tipcfg, px_padding=32, width_scale=width_scale, min_ceiling=64,
        )

    combo.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Preferred, QSizePolicy.Fixed)
    combo.clear()

    # 👇 Adjust combo width based on label + items
    adjust_combobox_width(combo, label_text=label)

    # 🛠 Ensure a sane minimum width fallback
    combo.setMinimumWidth(150)

    for v in items:
        combo.addItem(_disp(v, logical_key, label, tipcfg), v)

    # Select default
    default_val = tipcfg.get("default", (items[0] if items else None))
    ix = combo.findData(_canon(default_val))
    if ix >= 0:
        combo.setCurrentIndex(ix)

    # Signals
    combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(
        lambda _ix, lbl=label, cmb=combo: ctx._emit_filter_change(lbl, cmb)
    )
    combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(
        lambda _ix=None, cmb=combo, lbl=label: ctx._on_any_dropdown_changed(cmb.property("pm_key") or lbl)
    )

    # ⬅️ Create optional QLabel caption (if needed)
    caption = QLabel(label)
    combo._caption_label = caption  # store for reuse or test

    # 🔁 Attach ComboCaptionAdapter with layout sync
    ctx._maybe_attach_caption(combo, label, caption)

    # Adapter recompute
    try:
        adapter_attr = getattr(ComboCaptionAdapter, "_PROP_ATTR", "_combo_caption_adapter")
        _adapter = getattr(combo, adapter_attr, None)
        if isinstance(_adapter, ComboCaptionAdapter):
            if use_fast:
                _adapter.set_fast_mode(True)
            _adapter.set_debounce_ms(0)
            _adapter.recompute_now()
            QTimer.singleShot(0, lambda a=_adapter: a.set_debounce_ms(50))
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Rich tooltip (deferred)
    QTimer.singleShot(100, lambda: _attach_hover_delayed(combo, tipcfg, label))

    # Metadata
    combo.setProperty("pm_key", logical_key)
    combo.setProperty("pm_label", label)
    combo.setProperty("tooltip_uid", f"{logical_key}:{id(combo)}")

    print(f"[SizingCheck] {label} sizeHint: {combo.sizeHint().width()} | minWidth enforced: {combo.minimumWidth()}")

    return combo, logical_key


def _attach_hover_delayed(combo, tipcfg, label):
    """Attach hover help after layout is complete."""
    print(f"Attaching hover to: {label}")
    try:
        if not hasattr(combo, "_hover_tip_adapter"):
            _tip = tipcfg if tipcfg else {"tooltip": {"description": str(label)}}

            show_delay_ms = int(os.getenv("HOVERCARD_SHOW_DELAY_MS", "2000"))
            hide_delay_ms = int(os.getenv("HOVERCARD_HIDE_DELAY_MS", "0"))
            theme_mode = os.getenv("HOVERCARD_THEME", "light")

            success = attach_hover_help(
                combo,
                _tip,
                label=label,
                theme_mode=theme_mode,
                show_delay_ms=show_delay_ms,
                hide_delay_ms=hide_delay_ms,
            )

            if success:
                print(f"? Hover help successfully attached to: {label}")
            else:
                print(f"? Failed to attach hover help to: {label}")

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error attaching hover help to {label}: {e}")
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()

def _finalize_lane_visuals(ctx) -> None:
    ctx.dropdown_container.setUpdatesEnabled(True)
    ctx.dropdown_container.adjustSize()
    ctx.dropdown_scroll.updateGeometry()
    ctx._sync_chrome_heights()
    ctx._refresh_headers()

    # Force layout recalculation to ensure proper sizing
    try:
        ctx.dropdown_layout.activate()
        ctx.dropdown_container.updateGeometry()

        # Keep centered by balancing spacers
        ctx.dropdown_layout.setStretch(0, 1)  # left spacer
        ctx.dropdown_layout.setStretch(ctx.dropdown_layout.count() - 1, 1)  # right spacer

        # 🔧 Clean up any optional filler widget if present
        if hasattr(ctx, "_lane_filler"):
            ctx.dropdown_layout.removeWidget(ctx._lane_filler)
            ctx._lane_filler.deleteLater()
            del ctx._lane_filler

        # Force immediate repaint and layout update
        QCoreApplication.processEvents()
        ctx.dropdown_container.repaint()

    except Exception:
        pass

    print("[DEBUG] Final layout pass")
    print(f"  → dropdown_container size: {ctx.dropdown_container.size()}")
    print(f"  → dropdown_container minimumSize: {ctx.dropdown_container.minimumSize()}")
    print(f"  → dropdown_container sizeHint: {ctx.dropdown_container.sizeHint()}")
    print(f"  → dropdown_layout count: {ctx.dropdown_layout.count()}")

    # 🔍 Print widget chain upwards to debug layout constraints
    w = ctx.dropdown_container
    while w:
        print(f"[WIDGET CHAIN] {w.__class__.__name__} | size={w.size()} | sizePolicy={w.sizePolicy()}")
        w = w.parentWidget()


    for i in range(ctx.dropdown_layout.count()):
        item = ctx.dropdown_layout.itemAt(i)
        widget = item.widget()
        if widget:
            print(f"    [{i}] Widget: {widget.__class__.__name__} | visible={widget.isVisible()} | sizeHint={widget.sizeHint()}")
        else:
            spacer = item.spacerItem()
            if spacer:
                print(f"    [{i}] SpacerItem: expanding={spacer.expandingDirections()}")

def _post_build_dependencies_and_debug(ctx) -> None:
    ctx._rebuild_key_index()
    ctx._update_dependencies()

    # Wavelet-specific enable/disable pass (new name). Guard if not present.
    QTimer.singleShot(50, lambda: getattr(ctx, "_update_wavelet_on_off", lambda: None)())

    log.debug("=== FINAL WAVELET STATE DEBUG ===")
    ctx._debug_wavelet_state()
    ctx._debug_wavelet_dependencies()
    ctx._debug_label_to_tipcfg()

def _lifecycle_end_and_emit(ctx, built) -> None:
    ctx._building_lane = False
    QTimer.singleShot(0, lambda b=built: ctx._emit_initial_snapshot(b))
    ctx._after_dropdowns_rebuilt()

# ---- Local utilities (pure) --------------------------------------------------

def _canon(v):
    """Coerce textual defaults to int/float when unambiguous; otherwise pass through."""
    try:
        iv = int(v)
        if str(iv) == str(v):
            return iv
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        return float(v)
    except Exception:
        return v

def _resolve_tipcfg(ctx, logical_key: str, label: str) -> Dict:
    """Resolve tooltip configuration for a specific dropdown."""
    tip = {}

    # First try to get from key-based mapping (if available)
    if hasattr(ctx, "_key_to_tipcfg"):
        tip = dict(ctx._key_to_tipcfg.get(logical_key) or {})

    # If not found, try label-based mapping
    if not tip and hasattr(ctx, "_label_to_tipcfg"):
        tip = dict(ctx._label_to_tipcfg.get(str(label)) or {})

    # Ensure tooltip structure is correct
    if "tooltip" not in tip and ("description" in tip or "docs" in tip):
        # Convert old format to new format
        tip = {"tooltip": tip}

    return tip

def _disp(x: object, key: str, label: str, tipcfg: Dict) -> str:
    """Display string formatter routed to canonical helper to keep rules in one place."""
    return format_display_value(x, key=key, label=str(label), tipcfg=tipcfg)

def _curr_text(cmb: QComboBox) -> str:
    """Raw current value from ComboCaptionAdapter (if any) else combo text."""
    adapter_attr = getattr(ComboCaptionAdapter, "_PROP_ATTR", "_captionAdapter")
    adapter = getattr(cmb, adapter_attr, None)
    if isinstance(adapter, ComboCaptionAdapter):
        try:
            return adapter.get_raw_current_text()
        except Exception:
            pass
    return cmb.currentText()

def _install_dynamic_tooltip(
    combo: QComboBox,
    logical_key: str,
    label: str,
    pre: str,
    suf: str,
    tipcfg: Dict,
) -> None:
    """
    Keep the base Qt tooltip (small, immediate) updated to reflect the
    combo's current value, while the HoverCard shows richer delayed help.
    """
    base_cfg = {
        "key": logical_key,
        "name": f"{pre}{_curr_text(combo)}{suf}".strip(),
        "description": tipcfg.get("description") or str(label),
        "units": tipcfg.get("units"),
        "range": tipcfg.get("range"),
        "default": tipcfg.get("default"),
        "warning": tipcfg.get("warning"),
    }

    def _refresh_header(_ix=None, cmb=combo, k=logical_key, lbl=str(label), base=base_cfg, tp=tipcfg):
        pre2, suf2 = get_caption_affixes(key=k, label=lbl, tipcfg=tp)
        raw = _curr_text(cmb)
        # If units exist and raw value is numeric and lacks a unit suffix, append units for clarity
        if (not suf2) and tp.get("units") and _looks_numeric(raw) and not _ends_with_known_unit(raw):
            suf2 = f" {tp['units']}"
        cfg2 = dict(base)
        cfg2["name"] = f"{pre2}{raw}{suf2}".strip()
        apply_rich_tooltip(cmb, cfg2)

    combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(_refresh_header)
    _refresh_header()

    core_pairs = _pairs_for(ctx.core_main, ctx.core_caret, ctx.core_direct_map, ctx.core_nested_map)
    pro_pairs = _pairs_for(ctx.pro_main, ctx.pro_caret, ctx.pro_direct_map, ctx.pro_nested_map)
    log.debug(f"Core pairs: {len(core_pairs or [])}, Pro pairs: {len(pro_pairs or [])}")
    return core_pairs or [], pro_pairs or []

def _coerce_valid_selection_if_needed(ctx, core_pairs: Pairs, pro_pairs: Pairs) -> Tuple[Pairs, Pairs]:
    if core_pairs or pro_pairs:
        return core_pairs, pro_pairs

    changed = False
    # core main
    if not (ctx.core_main and (ctx.core_main in ctx.core_direct_map or ctx.core_main in ctx.core_nested_map)):
        ctx.core_main = next(iter(ctx.core_direct_map or ctx.core_nested_map or {}), None)
        changed = True
    if ctx.core_main in ctx.core_nested_map and not ctx.core_caret:
        ctx.core_caret = next(iter(ctx.core_nested_map[ctx.core_main]), None)  # type: ignore[index]
        changed = True
    # pro main
    if not (ctx.pro_main and (ctx.pro_main in ctx.pro_direct_map or ctx.pro_main in ctx.pro_nested_map)):
        ctx.pro_main = next(iter(ctx.pro_direct_map or ctx.pro_nested_map or {}), None)
        changed = True
    if ctx.pro_main in ctx.pro_nested_map and not ctx.pro_caret:
        ctx.pro_caret = next(iter(ctx.pro_nested_map[ctx.pro_main]), None)  # type: ignore[index]
        changed = True

    if changed:
        ctx._rebuild_core_caret_menu()
        ctx._rebuild_pro_caret_menu()
        return _compute_lane_pairs(ctx)

    return core_pairs, pro_pairs

def _prep_lane(ctx) -> None:
    ctx._clear_dropdown_lane()
    ctx.dropdown_container.setUpdatesEnabled(False)

    # 🔧 Ensure dropdown container has room to grow and expand
    lane_min_width = getattr(ctx, "_dropdown_lane_min_width", 800)
    ctx.dropdown_container.setMinimumWidth(lane_min_width)
    ctx.dropdown_container.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Fixed)

    # ✨ Improve layout spacing and margins for visual polish
    ctx.dropdown_layout.setContentsMargins(12, 0, 12, 0)
    ctx.dropdown_layout.setSpacing(6)

    # 🔧 Add invisible filler widget (helps maintain layout width under shrink)
    ctx._lane_filler = QWidget()
    ctx._lane_filler.setMinimumWidth(600)
    ctx._lane_filler.setVisible(False)
    ctx.dropdown_layout.addWidget(ctx._lane_filler)

    # ↔️ Add left and right spacers to center lane content
    ctx._left_spacer = QSpacerItem(0, 0, QSizePolicy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Minimum)
    ctx._right_spacer = QSpacerItem(0, 0, QSizePolicy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Minimum)
    ctx.dropdown_layout.addItem(ctx._left_spacer)

def _choose_active_pairs(ctx, core_pairs: Pairs, pro_pairs: Pairs) -> Pairs:
    combined: Pairs = []
    if getattr(ctx, "_active_lane", "core") == "core":
        combined.extend(core_pairs)
    else:
        combined.extend(pro_pairs)
    log.debug(f"Combined pairs count: {len(combined)}")
    for i, (label, items) in enumerate(combined):
        log.debug(f"Pair {i}: {label} -> {list(items)[:3]}...")
    return combined

def _build_all_combos(ctx, combined: Pairs) -> List[Tuple[str, QComboBox]]:
    built: List[Tuple[str, QComboBox]] = []

    # sizing toggles
    use_fast_default = bool(getattr(ctx, "_use_fast_charlen_widths", True))
    char_buf = int(getattr(ctx, "_contents_len_buffer", 3))
    precise_keys = set(getattr(ctx, "_precise_size_keys", set()))
    width_scale = float(getattr(ctx, "_dropdown_width_scale", 0.6))

    for label, items in combined:
        combo, logical_key = _build_one_combo(
            ctx=ctx,
            label=str(label),
            items=list(items),
            use_fast_default=use_fast_default,
            char_buf=char_buf,
            precise_keys=precise_keys,
            width_scale=width_scale,
        )
        ctx.dropdown_layout.addWidget(combo)
        ctx._dropdowns[f"{logical_key}::{label}"] = combo
        built.append((str(label), combo))

    # right spacer for symmetry
    ctx.dropdown_layout.addItem(ctx._right_spacer)
    return built

def _build_one_combo(
    *,
    ctx,
    label: str,
    items: Sequence[str],
    use_fast_default: bool,
    char_buf: int,
    precise_keys: set,
    width_scale: float,
) -> Tuple[QComboBox, str]:
    """Build, size, populate, connect, and decorate one QComboBox."""
    print(f"Building combo: {label}")

    combo = KandaDropdown(row_h=ctx._row_h)
    combo.setFixedHeight(ctx._row_h)

    logical_key = ctx._label_to_key.get(label, label)
    tipcfg = _resolve_tipcfg(ctx, logical_key, label)

    print(f"Combo {label} - tipcfg: {bool(tipcfg)}")
    if tipcfg:
        print(f"Tooltip keys: {list(tipcfg.keys())}")

    # Determine sizing path
    use_fast = use_fast_default and (logical_key not in precise_keys)
    pre, suf = get_caption_affixes(key=logical_key, label=label, tipcfg=tipcfg)

    if use_fast:
        apply_caption_aware_fast_sizing(
            combo, items, key=logical_key, label=label,
            tipcfg=tipcfg, char_buffer=char_buf, width_scale=width_scale,
        )
    else:
        apply_caption_aware_precise_sizing(
            combo, items, key=logical_key, label=label,
            tipcfg=tipcfg, px_padding=32, width_scale=width_scale, min_ceiling=64,
        )

    combo.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Preferred, QSizePolicy.Fixed)
    combo.clear()

    # 👇 Adjust combo width based on label + items
    adjust_combobox_width(combo, label_text=label)

    # 🛠 Ensure a sane minimum width fallback
    combo.setMinimumWidth(150)

    for v in items:
        combo.addItem(_disp(v, logical_key, label, tipcfg), v)

    # Select default
    default_val = tipcfg.get("default", (items[0] if items else None))
    ix = combo.findData(_canon(default_val))
    if ix >= 0:
        combo.setCurrentIndex(ix)

    # Signals
    combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(
        lambda _ix, lbl=label, cmb=combo: ctx._emit_filter_change(lbl, cmb)
    )
    combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(
        lambda _ix=None, cmb=combo, lbl=label: ctx._on_any_dropdown_changed(cmb.property("pm_key") or lbl)
    )

    # ⬅️ Create optional QLabel caption (if needed)
    caption = QLabel(label)
    combo._caption_label = caption  # store for reuse or test

    # 🔁 Attach ComboCaptionAdapter with layout sync
    ctx._maybe_attach_caption(combo, label, caption)

    # Adapter recompute
    try:
        adapter_attr = getattr(ComboCaptionAdapter, "_PROP_ATTR", "_combo_caption_adapter")
        _adapter = getattr(combo, adapter_attr, None)
        if isinstance(_adapter, ComboCaptionAdapter):
            if use_fast:
                _adapter.set_fast_mode(True)
            _adapter.set_debounce_ms(0)
            _adapter.recompute_now()
            QTimer.singleShot(0, lambda a=_adapter: a.set_debounce_ms(50))
    except Exception:
        pass

    # Rich tooltip (deferred)
    QTimer.singleShot(100, lambda: _attach_hover_delayed(combo, tipcfg, label))

    # Metadata
    combo.setProperty("pm_key", logical_key)
    combo.setProperty("pm_label", label)
    combo.setProperty("tooltip_uid", f"{logical_key}:{id(combo)}")

    print(f"[SizingCheck] {label} sizeHint: {combo.sizeHint().width()} | minWidth enforced: {combo.minimumWidth()}")

    return combo, logical_key


def _attach_hover_delayed(combo, tipcfg, label):
    """Attach hover help after layout is complete."""
    print(f"Attaching hover to: {label}")
    try:
        if not hasattr(combo, "_hover_tip_adapter"):
            _tip = tipcfg if tipcfg else {"tooltip": {"description": str(label)}}

            show_delay_ms = int(os.getenv("HOVERCARD_SHOW_DELAY_MS", "2000"))
            hide_delay_ms = int(os.getenv("HOVERCARD_HIDE_DELAY_MS", "0"))
            theme_mode = os.getenv("HOVERCARD_THEME", "light")

            success = attach_hover_help(
                combo,
                _tip,
                label=label,
                theme_mode=theme_mode,
                show_delay_ms=show_delay_ms,
                hide_delay_ms=hide_delay_ms,
            )

            if success:
                print(f"? Hover help successfully attached to: {label}")
            else:
                print(f"? Failed to attach hover help to: {label}")

    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error attaching hover help to {label}: {e}")
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()

def _finalize_lane_visuals(ctx) -> None:
    ctx.dropdown_container.setUpdatesEnabled(True)
    ctx.dropdown_container.adjustSize()
    ctx.dropdown_scroll.updateGeometry()
    ctx._sync_chrome_heights()
    ctx._refresh_headers()

    # Force layout recalculation to ensure proper sizing
    try:
        ctx.dropdown_layout.activate()
        ctx.dropdown_container.updateGeometry()

        # Keep centered by balancing spacers
        ctx.dropdown_layout.setStretch(0, 1)  # left spacer
        ctx.dropdown_layout.setStretch(ctx.dropdown_layout.count() - 1, 1)  # right spacer

        # 🔧 Clean up any optional filler widget if present
        if hasattr(ctx, "_lane_filler"):
            ctx.dropdown_layout.removeWidget(ctx._lane_filler)
            ctx._lane_filler.deleteLater()
            del ctx._lane_filler

        # Force immediate repaint and layout update
        QCoreApplication.processEvents()
        ctx.dropdown_container.repaint()

    except Exception:
        pass

    print("[DEBUG] Final layout pass")
    print(f"  → dropdown_container size: {ctx.dropdown_container.size()}")
    print(f"  → dropdown_container minimumSize: {ctx.dropdown_container.minimumSize()}")
    print(f"  → dropdown_container sizeHint: {ctx.dropdown_container.sizeHint()}")
    print(f"  → dropdown_layout count: {ctx.dropdown_layout.count()}")

    # 🔍 Print widget chain upwards to debug layout constraints
    w = ctx.dropdown_container
    while w:
        print(f"[WIDGET CHAIN] {w.__class__.__name__} | size={w.size()} | sizePolicy={w.sizePolicy()}")
        w = w.parentWidget()


    for i in range(ctx.dropdown_layout.count()):
        item = ctx.dropdown_layout.itemAt(i)
        widget = item.widget()
        if widget:
            print(f"    [{i}] Widget: {widget.__class__.__name__} | visible={widget.isVisible()} | sizeHint={widget.sizeHint()}")
        else:
            spacer = item.spacerItem()
            if spacer:
                print(f"    [{i}] SpacerItem: expanding={spacer.expandingDirections()}")

def _post_build_dependencies_and_debug(ctx) -> None:
    ctx._rebuild_key_index()
    ctx._update_dependencies()

    # Wavelet-specific enable/disable pass (new name). Guard if not present.
    QTimer.singleShot(50, lambda: getattr(ctx, "_update_wavelet_on_off", lambda: None)())

    log.debug("=== FINAL WAVELET STATE DEBUG ===")
    ctx._debug_wavelet_state()
    ctx._debug_wavelet_dependencies()
    ctx._debug_label_to_tipcfg()

def _lifecycle_end_and_emit(ctx, built) -> None:
    ctx._building_lane = False
    QTimer.singleShot(0, lambda b=built: ctx._emit_initial_snapshot(b))
    ctx._after_dropdowns_rebuilt()

# ---- Local utilities (pure) --------------------------------------------------

def _canon(v):
    """Coerce textual defaults to int/float when unambiguous; otherwise pass through."""
    try:
        iv = int(v)
        if str(iv) == str(v):
            return iv
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        return float(v)
    except Exception:
        return v

def _resolve_tipcfg(ctx, logical_key: str, label: str) -> Dict:
    """Resolve tooltip configuration for a specific dropdown."""
    tip = {}

    # First try to get from key-based mapping (if available)
    if hasattr(ctx, "_key_to_tipcfg"):
        tip = dict(ctx._key_to_tipcfg.get(logical_key) or {})

    # If not found, try label-based mapping
    if not tip and hasattr(ctx, "_label_to_tipcfg"):
        tip = dict(ctx._label_to_tipcfg.get(str(label)) or {})

    # Ensure tooltip structure is correct
    if "tooltip" not in tip and ("description" in tip or "docs" in tip):
        # Convert old format to new format
        tip = {"tooltip": tip}

    return tip

def _disp(x: object, key: str, label: str, tipcfg: Dict) -> str:
    """Display string formatter routed to canonical helper to keep rules in one place."""
    return format_display_value(x, key=key, label=str(label), tipcfg=tipcfg)

def _curr_text(cmb: QComboBox) -> str:
    """Raw current value from ComboCaptionAdapter (if any) else combo text."""
    adapter_attr = getattr(ComboCaptionAdapter, "_PROP_ATTR", "_captionAdapter")
    adapter = getattr(cmb, adapter_attr, None)
    if isinstance(adapter, ComboCaptionAdapter):
        try:
            return adapter.get_raw_current_text()
        except Exception:
            pass
    return cmb.currentText()

def _install_dynamic_tooltip(
    combo: QComboBox,
    logical_key: str,
    label: str,
    pre: str,
    suf: str,
    tipcfg: Dict,
) -> None:
    """
    Keep the base Qt tooltip (small, immediate) updated to reflect the
    combo's current value, while the HoverCard shows richer delayed help.
    """
    base_cfg = {
        "key": logical_key,
        "name": f"{pre}{_curr_text(combo)}{suf}".strip(),
        "description": tipcfg.get("description") or str(label),
        "units": tipcfg.get("units"),
        "range": tipcfg.get("range"),
        "default": tipcfg.get("default"),
        "warning": tipcfg.get("warning"),
    }

    def _refresh_header(_ix=None, cmb=combo, k=logical_key, lbl=str(label), base=base_cfg, tp=tipcfg):
        pre2, suf2 = get_caption_affixes(key=k, label=lbl, tipcfg=tp)
        raw = _curr_text(cmb)
        # If units exist and raw value is numeric and lacks a unit suffix, append units for clarity
        if (not suf2) and tp.get("units") and _looks_numeric(raw) and not _ends_with_known_unit(raw):
            suf2 = f" {tp['units']}"
        cfg2 = dict(base)
        cfg2["name"] = f"{pre2}{raw}{suf2}".strip()
        apply_rich_tooltip(cmb, cfg2)

    combo.currentIndexChanged.connect(_refresh_header)
    _refresh_header()

"""
Reusable combobox lane template for Core/Pro filter menus.

This module exposes:
- TransparentItemDelegate
- KandaDropdown (styled compact QComboBox)
- DualArrowButton (header + caret button)
- ComboFiltersTemplate (QToolBar): JSON/maps-driven dynamic combobox lane
    • filterChanged(label, key, value) Signal
    • reload_from_json(...)
    • reload_from_maps(...)
    • get_dropdown_values()
    • same selection/header behavior as the original FilterToolbar

Notes
-----
• Fonts are now **platform-neutral** in stylesheets (no hard-coded family, no bold).
  The global QApplication font should be set elsewhere (e.g., Segoe UI / SF Text / DejaVu Sans).
• This file focuses on structure, readability, and clear responsibilities.

Subclasses can extend the hooks:
    _after_dropdown_area_built(main_layout)
    _after_dropdowns_rebuilt()
    _sync_external_chrome_heights(lane_h)
"""

# ------------------------ Hover help adapter (canonical path) ------------------------
# --- helper imports (incremental refactor; keep fallbacks) ---
try:
    from k05_combobox_forge.k05_4_cmbbx_constructor.cmbbx_template_helpers.value_text_utils_cmbbx_template_helper import (
        _looks_numeric as _looks_numeric,
        _ends_with_known_unit as _ends_with_known_unit,
    )
except Exception:
    # Fallbacks (identical logic) keep the monolith fully functional.
    import re as _re
    def _looks_numeric(val: str) -> bool:
        """
        Fallback: Return True if the string looks like a scalar number.
        """
        #------------1. sanitize input
        s = str(val).strip()
        #-------------2. numeric regex
        return bool(_re.fullmatch(r"[+-]?(\d+(\.\d*)?|\.\d+)", s))

    def _ends_with_known_unit(val: str) -> bool:
        """
        Fallback: Guard against double-units in captions (Hz, dB, uV/µV).
        """
        #------------1. normalize
        s = str(val)
        #-------------2. check unit suffix
        return bool(_re.search(r"(Hz|dB|µV|uV)\s*(\+.*)?$", s))

try:
    from k05_combobox_forge.k05_4_cmbbx_constructor.cmbbx_template_helpers.dependency_eval_cmbbx_template_helper import (
        check_condition as _dep_check_condition
    )
except Exception:
    # Fallback (identical logic) so behavior remains unchanged.
    def _dep_check_condition(current_value: str, condition: dict) -> bool:
        """
        Fallback: Evaluate condition (equals/in/not/truthy/numeric).
        """
        #------------1. trivial
        if not condition:
            return True
        current = str(current_value).strip().lower()
        #-------------2. string ops
        if "equals" in condition:
            return current == str(condition["equals"]).strip().lower()
        if "equals_any" in condition or "in" in condition:
            pool = condition.get("equals_any") or condition.get("in") or []
            return any(current == str(v).strip().lower() for v in pool)
        if "not_equals" in condition:
            return current != str(condition["not_equals"]).strip().lower()
        if "not_in" in condition:
            pool = condition.get("not_in") or []
            return all(current != str(v).strip().lower() for v in pool)
        #-------------3. truthy/falsy
        if condition.get("truthy", False):
            return current in {"on", "true", "1", "yes"}
        if condition.get("falsy", False):
            return current in {"off", "false", "0", "no", ""}
        #--------------4. numeric
        try:
            cnum = float(current)
        except Exception:
            cnum = None
        if cnum is not None:
            if "gte" in condition and not (cnum >= float(condition["gte"])): return False
            if "lte" in condition and not (cnum <= float(condition["lte"])): return False
            if "gt"  in condition and not (cnum >  float(condition["gt"])):  return False
            if "lt"  in condition and not (cnum <  float(condition["lt"])):  return False
            return True
        #--------------5. default
        return True


# ------------------------ 3. Local utilities ------------------------
Pairs = List[Tuple[str, Sequence[str]]]
log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
_rootlog = logging.getLogger()  # go through root DEBUG config


def _looks_numeric(val: str) -> bool:
    """
    Return True if the string looks like a scalar number.

    Steps
    -----
    1) Strip whitespace.
    2) Test against a float/integer regex.
    """
    #------------1. sanitize input
    s = str(val).strip()
    #-------------2. match numeric pattern
    return bool(re.fullmatch(r"[+-]?(\d+(\.\d*)?|\.\d+)", s))


def _ends_with_known_unit(val: str) -> bool:
    """
    Guard against double-units in captions (Hz, dB, uV/µV, optional suffix additions).

    Steps
    -----
    1) Convert to string.
    2) Regex-check for known trailing units (optionally followed by "+ ...").
    """
    #------------1. normalize
    s = str(val)
    #-------------2. check unit suffix
    return bool(re.search(r"(Hz|dB|µV|uV)\s*(\+.*)?$", s))

class ComboFiltersTemplate(QToolBar):
    """
    JSON/maps-driven combobox toolbar. Rebuilds comboboxes dynamically as the
    main/caret selections change and emits filterChanged(label, key, value).

    Signals
    -------
    filterChanged(str, str, str)
        Emitted when any dropdown changes, with label, logical key, and raw value.
    """

    # --- canonical boolean tokens used in dependency checks ---
    _BOOL_TRUE = {"on", "true", "1", "yes", "y", "t"}
    _BOOL_FALSE = {"off", "false", "0", "no", "n", "f", ""}

    filterChanged = Signal(str, str, str)  # label, key, value

    def __init__(
        self,
        parent: Optional[QWidget] = None,
        *,
        scale: float = 1.0,
        core_json: Optional[str] = None,
        pro_json: Optional[str] = None,
    ):
        """
        Construct a toolbar capable of showing a dynamic combobox lane.

        Parameters
        ----------
        parent : QWidget | None
            Parent widget.
        scale : float
            Visual scaling factor for the lane and headers.
        core_json : str | None
            Path to the Core filters JSON file.
        pro_json : str | None
            Path to the Pro filters JSON file.

        Steps
        -----
        1) Initialize state and default sizes.
        2) Build base UI skeleton and animations.
        3) Load option data and build menus.
        4) Coerce valid selection and render first dropdown lane.
        5) Refresh headers and caret highlighting.
        6) Schedule debug traces (optional).
        """
        #------------1. base init + state
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._scale = float(scale) if scale and scale > 0 else 1.0
        self._row_h = 28
        self._core_json = core_json
        self._pro_json = pro_json
        self._building_lane = False
        self._dropdown_width_scale: float = 0.6  # reduce heads by 40%

        self.core_main: Optional[str] = None
        self.core_caret: Optional[str] = None
        self.pro_main: Optional[str] = None
        self.pro_caret: Optional[str] = None

        self.core_direct_map: Dict[str, Pairs] = {}
        self.core_nested_map: Dict[str, Dict[str, Pairs]] = {}
        self.pro_direct_map: Dict[str, Pairs] = {}
        self.pro_nested_map: Dict[str, Dict[str, Pairs]] = {}

        self._dropdowns: Dict[str, QComboBox] = {}
        self._label_to_key: Dict[str, str] = {}
        self._label_to_tipcfg: Dict[str, dict] = {}

        #-------------2. base sizes and immovable toolbar
        self._base_lane_h = 28
        self._base_head_w = 120
        self._base_caret_w = 24
        self.setMovable(False)
        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Fixed)

        #--------------3. UI skeleton + animations
        self._setup_ui()
        self._setup_animations()

        #--------------4. load data + build menus + render first lane
        self._setup_option_data()
        self._rebuild_core_menus()
        self._rebuild_pro_menus()
        self._coerce_valid_selection()
        self.update_dropdowns()

        #--------------5. headers + caret highlight + active lane
        self._refresh_caret_highlight()
        self._refresh_headers()
        self._active_lane = "core"

        #--------------6. sizing strategy + debug helpers
        self._first_layout_pass_done: bool = False
        self._use_fast_charlen_widths = True
        self._contents_len_buffer = 3
        self._precise_size_keys: set[str] = set()
        QTimer.singleShot(500, self._debug_wavelet_dependencies)
        QTimer.singleShot(1000, self._debug_wavelet_state)

        self._attach_hover_to_headers()

    # ------------------------ 4.4  Dropdown area ------------------------
    def _setup_dropdown_area(self) -> None:
        """
        Construct the scrollable lane that will hold the dropdowns.

        Steps
        -----
        1) Probe a temporary combobox to estimate a comfortable lane height.
        2) Create a QScrollArea with a single row container.
        3) Use an HBox layout with symmetric spacers to keep the row centered.
        """
        #------------1. probe height safely
        probe = KandaDropdown()
        probe.addItem("Probe")
        lane_h = probe.sizeHint().height() + 4
        probe.deleteLater()

        #-------------2. scroll area + container
        self.dropdown_scroll = QScrollArea()
        self.dropdown_scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
        self.dropdown_scroll.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.dropdown_scroll.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Fixed)
        self.dropdown_scroll.setFrameShape(QFrame.NoFrame)
        self.dropdown_scroll.setFixedHeight(lane_h)

        self.dropdown_container = QWidget(self.dropdown_scroll)
        self.dropdown_container.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Fixed)

        #-------------3. centered lane layout
        self.dropdown_layout = QHBoxLayout(self.dropdown_container)
        self.dropdown_layout.setAlignment(Qt.AlignHCenter)
        self.dropdown_layout.setContentsMargins(4, 0, 4, 0)
        self.dropdown_layout.setSpacing(8)
        self._left_spacer = None
        self._right_spacer = None

        self.dropdown_scroll.setWidget(self.dropdown_container)

    def _dep_check_condition(current_value: str, condition: dict) -> bool:
        """
        Fallback: Evaluate condition (equals/in/not/truthy/numeric).
        """
        #------------1. trivial
        if not condition:
            return True
        current = str(current_value).strip().lower()
        #-------------2. string ops
        if "equals" in condition:
            return current == str(condition["equals"]).strip().lower()
        if "equals_any" in condition or "in" in condition:
            pool = condition.get("equals_any") or condition.get("in") or []
            return any(current == str(v).strip().lower() for v in pool)
        if "not_equals" in condition:
            return current != str(condition["not_equals"]).strip().lower()
        if "not_in" in condition:
            pool = condition.get("not_in") or []
            return all(current != str(v).strip().lower() for v in pool)
        #-------------3. truthy/falsy
        if condition.get("truthy", False):
            return current in {"on", "true", "1", "yes"}
        if condition.get("falsy", False):
            return current in {"off", "false", "0", "no", ""}
        #--------------4. numeric
        try:
            cnum = float(current)
        except Exception:
            cnum = None
        if cnum is not None:
            if "gte" in condition and not (cnum >= float(condition["gte"])): return False
            if "lte" in condition and not (cnum <= float(condition["lte"])): return False
            if "gt"  in condition and not (cnum >  float(condition["gt"])):  return False
            if "lt"  in condition and not (cnum <  float(condition["lt"])):  return False
            return True
        #--------------5. default
        return True


# ------------------------ 3. Local utilities ------------------------
Pairs = List[Tuple[str, Sequence[str]]]
log = logging.getLogger(__name__)
_rootlog = logging.getLogger()  # go through root DEBUG config


def _looks_numeric(val: str) -> bool:
    """
    Return True if the string looks like a scalar number.

    Steps
    -----
    1) Strip whitespace.
    2) Test against a float/integer regex.
    """
    #------------1. sanitize input
    s = str(val).strip()
    #-------------2. match numeric pattern
    return bool(re.fullmatch(r"[+-]?(\d+(\.\d*)?|\.\d+)", s))


def _ends_with_known_unit(val: str) -> bool:
    """
    Guard against double-units in captions (Hz, dB, uV/µV, optional suffix additions).

    Steps
    -----
    1) Convert to string.
    2) Regex-check for known trailing units (optionally followed by "+ ...").
    """
    #------------1. normalize
    s = str(val)
    #-------------2. check unit suffix
    return bool(re.search(r"(Hz|dB|µV|uV)\s*(\+.*)?$", s))

except AttributeError:

# =============================================================================
# #### - 4. ComboFiltersTemplate (toolbar: menus + dynamic combobox lane) ####
# =============================================================================

class ComboFiltersTemplate(QToolBar):
    """
    JSON/maps-driven combobox toolbar. Rebuilds comboboxes dynamically as the
    main/caret selections change and emits filterChanged(label, key, value).

    Signals
    -------
    filterChanged(str, str, str)
        Emitted when any dropdown changes, with label, logical key, and raw value.
    """

    # --- canonical boolean tokens used in dependency checks ---
    _BOOL_TRUE = {"on", "true", "1", "yes", "y", "t"}
    _BOOL_FALSE = {"off", "false", "0", "no", "n", "f", ""}

    filterChanged = Signal(str, str, str)  # label, key, value

    def __init__(
        self,
        parent: Optional[QWidget] = None,
        *,
        scale: float = 1.0,
        core_json: Optional[str] = None,
        pro_json: Optional[str] = None,
    ):
        """
        Construct a toolbar capable of showing a dynamic combobox lane.

        Parameters
        ----------
        parent : QWidget | None
            Parent widget.
        scale : float
            Visual scaling factor for the lane and headers.
        core_json : str | None
            Path to the Core filters JSON file.
        pro_json : str | None
            Path to the Pro filters JSON file.

        Steps
        -----
        1) Initialize state and default sizes.
        2) Build base UI skeleton and animations.
        3) Load option data and build menus.
        4) Coerce valid selection and render first dropdown lane.
        5) Refresh headers and caret highlighting.
        6) Schedule debug traces (optional).
        """
        #------------1. base init + state
        super().__init__(parent)
        self._scale = float(scale) if scale and scale > 0 else 1.0
        self._row_h = 28
        self._core_json = core_json
        self._pro_json = pro_json
        self._building_lane = False
        self._dropdown_width_scale: float = 0.6  # reduce heads by 40%

        self.core_main: Optional[str] = None
        self.core_caret: Optional[str] = None
        self.pro_main: Optional[str] = None
        self.pro_caret: Optional[str] = None

        self.core_direct_map: Dict[str, Pairs] = {}
        self.core_nested_map: Dict[str, Dict[str, Pairs]] = {}
        self.pro_direct_map: Dict[str, Pairs] = {}
        self.pro_nested_map: Dict[str, Dict[str, Pairs]] = {}

        self._dropdowns: Dict[str, QComboBox] = {}
        self._label_to_key: Dict[str, str] = {}
        self._label_to_tipcfg: Dict[str, dict] = {}

        #-------------2. base sizes and immovable toolbar
        self._base_lane_h = 28
        self._base_head_w = 120
        self._base_caret_w = 24
        self.setMovable(False)
        self.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Fixed)

        #--------------3. UI skeleton + animations
        self._setup_ui()
        self._setup_animations()

        #--------------4. load data + build menus + render first lane
        self._setup_option_data()
        self._rebuild_core_menus()
        self._rebuild_pro_menus()
        self._coerce_valid_selection()

        assert hasattr(self, "update_dropdowns"), "update_dropdowns not defined!"
        self.update_dropdowns()

        #--------------5. headers + caret highlight + active lane
        self._refresh_caret_highlight()
        self._refresh_headers()
        self._active_lane = "core"

        #--------------6. sizing strategy + debug helpers
        self._first_layout_pass_done: bool = False
        self._use_fast_charlen_widths = True
        self._contents_len_buffer = 3
        self._precise_size_keys: set[str] = set()
        QTimer.singleShot(500, self._debug_wavelet_dependencies)
        QTimer.singleShot(1000, self._debug_wavelet_state)

        self._attach_hover_to_headers()

        print("📣 ComboFiltersTemplate __init__ running...")

    # ------------------------ 4.1  Canonical boolean token ------------------------
    ####-------unit: class.ui_and_layout ---------####
    # ------------------------ 4.1  Canonical boolean token ------------------------
    @staticmethod
    def _canon_bool_token(v: object) -> str:
        return _canon_bool_token_helper(v)

    # ------------------------ 4.2  Width scaling API ------------------------
    def set_dropdown_width_scale(self, scale: float) -> None:
        _set_dropdown_width_scale_helper(self, scale)

    # ------------------------ 4.3  UI skeleton ------------------------
    def _setup_ui(self) -> None:
        _setup_ui_helper(self)

    def _after_dropdown_area_built(self, _main_layout) -> None:
        """Subclass hook to append extra chrome (arrows/presets/etc.) after the lane is built."""
        # left intentionally empty; subclasses may override

    # ------------------------ 4.4  Dropdown area ------------------------
    def _setup_dropdown_area(self) -> None:
        """
        Construct the scrollable lane that will hold the dropdowns.

        Steps
        -----
        1) Probe a temporary combobox to estimate a comfortable lane height.
        2) Create a QScrollArea with a single row container.
        3) Use an HBox layout with symmetric spacers to keep the row centered.
        """
        #------------1. probe height safely
        probe = KandaDropdown()
        probe.addItem("Probe")
        lane_h = probe.sizeHint().height() + 4
        probe.deleteLater()

        #-------------2. scroll area + container
        self.dropdown_scroll = QScrollArea()
        self.dropdown_scroll.setWidgetResizable(True)
        self.dropdown_scroll.setHorizontalScrollBarPolicy(Qt.ScrollBarAlwaysOff)
        self.dropdown_scroll.setSizePolicy(QSizePolicy.Expanding, QSizePolicy.Fixed)
        self.dropdown_scroll.setFrameShape(QFrame.NoFrame)
        self.dropdown_scroll.setFixedHeight(lane_h)

        self.dropdown_container = QWidget(self.dropdown_scroll)

# utils/inject_core_head_x.py
from __future__ import annotations
from pathlib import Path
import json
from typing import Dict, Any

def inject_core_head_X(ft, cfg: Dict[str, Any]) -> None:
    """
    Populate FilterToolbar with the given JSON (dict) and select Core main='X'.
    Compatible with pair-shape toolbars (["Label", [items...]]).
    """
    # 1) Build pair-shape maps from your dict-shape JSON (robust to existing code)
    def _to_pairs_list(entries):
        out = []
        for e in entries:
            # dict-shape: {"label": "...", "items": [...]}
            if isinstance(e, dict) and "label" in e and "items" in e:
                out.append([str(e["label"]), [str(x) for x in e["items"]]])
            else:
                # already pair-shape? keep as-is
                out.append(e)
        return out

    direct_pairs = {}
    for main, entries in (cfg.get("direct") or {}).items():
        direct_pairs[str(main)] = _to_pairs_list(entries)

    nested_pairs = {}
    for main, submap in (cfg.get("nested") or {}).items():
        if isinstance(submap, dict) and "$include" not in submap:
            nested_pairs[str(main)] = {
                str(sub): _to_pairs_list(lst) for sub, lst in submap.items()
            }
        else:
            # If you expand $include elsewhere, you can ignore or resolve it here
            nested_pairs[str(main)] = {}

    # 2) Inject into the toolbar and switch to head "X"
    ft.reload_from_maps(
        core_direct=direct_pairs,
        core_nested=nested_pairs,
        pro_direct=getattr(ft, "pro_direct_map", None),   # keep whatever Pro had
        pro_nested=getattr(ft, "pro_nested_map", None),
        core_main="X",
        core_caret=None,
        maps_version=f"core:{cfg.get('version','?')}",
    )

    # 3) Make sure lane is rebuilt and visible
    if hasattr(ft, "_on_core_main_selected"):
        ft._on_core_main_selected("X")
    ft.update_dropdowns()



# k01_core_eeg/k01_3_eeg_visualizer/visualizer_core_helpers/display_pyside6_eeg_visualizer.py
from __future__ import annotations

import inspect
import os
import logging

from PySide6.QtCore import QTimer
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QToolBar

from k01_core_eeg.k01_1_main_win_builder.main_win_builder import EEGMainWindowBuilder
from k01_core_eeg.k01_3_eeg_visualizer.visualizer_core_helpers.core_input_manager import InputManager
from k05_combobox_forge.k05_8_eeg_middle_tab_bar_cmbbx_lane.cmbbx_lane_middle_bar import DrpdwnPanelMiddleBar

# Import the toolbar via the package __init__ (handles new module or shim)
try:
    from k05_combobox_forge.k05_4_cmbbx_constructor import MiddleTabBarFilters as FilterToolbar
except Exception:
    # Optional: fallback to legacy shim if you kept it
    from k05_combobox_forge.k05_4_cmbbx_constructor.cmbbox_forge import FilterToolbar  # type: ignore[no-redef]

import k05_combobox_forge.k05_4_cmbbx_constructor as cmbbx_ctor

logger = logging.getLogger(__name__)


def _find_filters_toolbar(core):
    """
    Prefer the middle lane toolbar (DrpdwnPanelMiddleBar) if present.
    Fallback to a 'close-capable' QToolBar. Last resort: first QToolBar.
    """
    # 1) Common attribute names
    for attr in ("filters_toolbar", "top_toolbar", "toolbar"):
        tb = getattr(core, attr, None)
        if isinstance(tb, DrpdwnPanelMiddleBar):  # <-- prefer middle lane
            return tb
        if isinstance(tb, QToolBar):
            candidate = tb  # keep as fallback  # noqa: F841

    # 2) Search the main window tree
    mw = getattr(core, "main_window", None)
    if mw is not None:
        # Prefer the actual middle bar class
        lst = mw.findChildren(DrpdwnPanelMiddleBar)
        if lst:
            return lst[0]
        # Else: a QToolBar that looks close-capable
        for tb in mw.findChildren(QToolBar):
            if hasattr(tb, "set_close_action") or hasattr(tb, "close_eeg_requested"):
                return tb
        generic = mw.findChildren(QToolBar)
        if generic:
            return generic[0]
    return None


def _wire_close_button(core):
    """
    Attach the Close-EEG behavior to the toolbar close button.
    Prefers toolbar.set_close_action(core.on_close_clicked).
    Falls back to toolbar.close_eeg_requested → core.on_close_clicked.
    """
    tb = _find_filters_toolbar(core)
    if tb is None:
        logger.warning("[UI] Filters toolbar not found; close button will not be wired.")
        return

    # Preferred: setter API added in the toolbar
    if hasattr(tb, "set_close_action"):
        try:
            tb.set_close_action(core.on_close_clicked)
            logger.debug("[UI] Close action wired via set_close_action.")
            return
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("[UI] set_close_action failed; trying signal fallback.")

    # Fallback: signal from toolbar
    if hasattr(tb, "close_eeg_requested"):
        try:
            # avoid double-connects in case of repeated launches
            try:
                tb.close_eeg_requested.disconnect(core.on_close_clicked)
            except Exception:
                pass
            tb.close_eeg_requested.connect(core.on_close_clicked)
            logger.debug("[UI] Close action wired via close_eeg_requested signal.")
            return
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("[UI] close_eeg_requested connect failed.")

    logger.warning("[UI] Toolbar has no set_close_action or close_eeg_requested; close button may be inert.")


def _wire_unified_params(core) -> bool:
    """
    No-k05, duck-typed wiring:
    - If a filters toolbar exists, optionally share a param manager and lane provider
      without importing any k05 modules.
    - Also hide dropdown chrome pre-load if the toolbar exposes that API.
    Returns True if a toolbar was found (wiring attempted), else False.
    """
    tb = _find_filters_toolbar(core)
    if tb is None:
        return False

    # Hide lane chrome at startup if supported (prevents early nav arrows)
    if hasattr(tb, "hide_dropdowns"):
        try:
            tb.hide_dropdowns()
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("[UI] hide_dropdowns() failed on toolbar")

    # Param manager: reuse visualizer's if present
    pm = getattr(core, "eeg_param_manager", None)
    if pm is not None and hasattr(tb, "set_param_manager"):
        try:
            tb.set_param_manager(pm)
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("[UI] set_param_manager(...) failed")

    # Lane provider: prefer a bound callable if available
    lane_provider = None
    if hasattr(core, "active_lane") and callable(getattr(core, "active_lane")):
        lane_provider = core.active_lane
    elif hasattr(core, "dropdown_integrator") and hasattr(core.dropdown_integrator, "active_lane"):
        lane_provider = core.dropdown_integrator.active_lane  # bound method

    if lane_provider and hasattr(tb, "set_lane_provider"):
        try:
            tb.set_lane_provider(lane_provider)
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("[UI] set_lane_provider(...) failed")

    return True


def display_pyside6_eeg_visualizer(core) -> None:
    EEGMainWindowBuilder(core).build_and_show()

    # --- Version & source diagnostics for the combobox constructor package ---
    try:
        k05_ver = getattr(cmbbx_ctor, "__version__", "unknown")
        src_file = os.path.abspath(inspect.getfile(cmbbx_ctor))
        # Class may be re-exported or shimmed; handle gracefully
        ft_cls = getattr(cmbbx_ctor, "FilterToolbar", None)
        ft_name = getattr(ft_cls, "__name__", "Unavailable")
        logging.getLogger(__name__).info(
            "[k05 ctor] version=%s, FilterToolbar=%s, module=%s",
            k05_ver, ft_name, src_file
        )
    except Exception:
        logging.getLogger(__name__).exception("[k05 ctor] version/source check failed")

    core.input_mgr = InputManager(core)
    if hasattr(core.input_mgr, "install"):
        core.input_mgr.install()

    core.install_key_handler()
    QTimer.singleShot(0, core.canvas.setFocus)
    QTimer.singleShot(100, core.force_canvas_focus)

    _wire_close_button(core)

    tb = _find_filters_toolbar(core)
    if tb is not None:
        try:
            tb.hide()
            # When EEG loads, show the middle bar AND “poke” its FilterToolbar child
            def _show_and_poke():
                try:
                    tb.show()
                    # ✅ Use safe isinstance check to prevent TypeError
                    if isinstance(FilterToolbar, type):
                        fts = tb.findChildren(FilterToolbar)
                    else:
                        logger.warning("FilterToolbar is not a class. Skipping findChildren.")
                        return

                    if fts:
                        ft = fts[0]
                        if hasattr(ft, "_debug_state"):
                            ft._debug_state("wire.before_poke")

                        if hasattr(ft, "_coerce_valid_selection"):
                            ft._coerce_valid_selection()
                        ft.update_dropdowns()

                        if hasattr(ft, "_debug_state"):
                            ft._debug_state("wire.after_poke")

                        if hasattr(tb, "show_all_dropdowns"):
                            tb.show_all_dropdowns()
                        if hasattr(tb, "show_dropdowns"):
                            tb.show_dropdowns()
                except Exception:
                    logger.exception("[UI] _show_and_poke failed")

            core.eeg_loaded_signal.connect(_show_and_poke)
        except Exception:
            logger.exception("[UI] Could not hide/show filters toolbar safely.")

    # Optional re-try for parameter/lane unification
    wired = _wire_unified_params(core)
    if not wired:
        QTimer.singleShot(0, lambda: _wire_unified_params(core))

# from k05_combobox_forge.k05_4_cmbbx_constructor.cmbbox_forge import FilterToolbar
